title: Angel of Love, 1 dollar
descriptionPlain: Description The design speaks of love in a quiet, universal way. An angel holding a heart radiates warmth and tenderness, while floral details and a soft composition create a peaceful, affectionate mood. A meaningful choice for those in love, or for someone you hold close in your heart.
